claim: SealedRejectDie's sentence for a role that is not known (REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN), and the goals desk's and the export shelf's read-only reasons for the same state, no longer say the role has not been read yet or is not known yet, or that it will clear, or to reload. Each is shown when useAuth().activeRole is null (SealedRejectDie: roleUnknown = activeRole === null || activeRole === undefined, which selects REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN for the legacy-reject-role-note; useGoalsDesk: activeRole === null; useReportExports: activeRole == null). activeRole is null in more than one state, including before the first /auth/me/role read returns, after a failed read, and when that read finds no role for this person here; /auth/me/role reads only the user_restaurant_access row with is_active = true (auth.service.ts getUserRoleAtRestaurant), while the gateway's assertCanManageRestaurant reads the legacy users row when the access read gives no role (organizations.service.ts lookupRestaurantRole). AuthContext asks about the page's active house, which can differ from the stored token's house, and JwtAuthGuard refuses with 403 a role read that names any house but the token's (assertTenantMatch), which the page records as a failed read. For the token's house, a token naming a house where the person holds no active access row is refused before that route answers (validateJwtPayload, 401 HOUSE_ACCESS_ENDED, and a 503 when that row cannot be read), so the states the code allows in which a read finds no role include an active row whose role is NULL (the column is nullable and the user_restaurant_access_role_known CHECK lets NULL through; production held no NULL role on 2026-09-02, per that migration's header) and a failure of the route's own read, which getUserRoleAtRestaurant answers as no role; for a NULL role the cancel gate's check reads the legacy users row instead, so a member whose users row names this house with the role manager or owner passes that check while activeRole is null. Each sentence now says the role is not confirmed here and names who to ask, with no promise that it clears. REJECT_NEEDS_A_MANAGER now says this page has the person as staff, since, when a read is made, activeRole keeps its old value until that read returns, including after a house switch (with no user, no token or no valid house it is set to null at once). The verify pins the three sentences, the staff sentence's new clause, SealedRejectDie's wiring of roleUnknown to REJECT_ROLE_UNKNOWN in both the role note and the onChallenge fallback, its role-note render, and the null-state list in both of SealedRejectDie's docblocks; it requires the titles of the three [REVERT-FAILS] tests (each of those tests fails against the sources at 1c1a676f8); and fails if 'clear in a moment', 'Your role at this restaurant has not been read' or 'Your role at this restaurant is not known yet' appears in any .ts, .tsx, .js or .jsx file under apps/web/src or apps/mobile/src, with adjacent string literals joined, and it requires that walk to read more than 500 files. A missing file fails the verify (exit 1). It is static text matching: it does not render the pages or run the tests.
